gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Wiry and loud. Happy Monkey draws its heading in one ruler-straight line, while Sawarabi Gothic keeps its sans body quiet, with curves that stay open, so use it at a modest size.
gen-gf-offside-gf-cal-sans: Wide-tracked and wilful, Offside lets its curves refuse to close, holding one level beat. Cal Sans follows in plain sans-serif strokes of single width, with short ascenders and a tall x-height.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-zilla-slab: Bold blocky Pixelify Sans runs its identical bars across the heading line, each c gaping like a bent paperclip. Zilla Slab then settles underneath with sturdy slab-serif curves.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-encode-sans-semi: Hand-drawn and cheeky, Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width, so its n arches grow as thick as the stems beside them. Encode Sans Semi Condensed keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
